## Ruled-out approaches
- Do not retry the `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` covering index; it doubled ingest write latency.
- Do not restore per-currency invoice loading or individual `Money(...)` conversions; one-pass aggregation and batched minor-unit conversion replaced them.
- Any `ledgerly/storage/queries.py` change requires fresh `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` output in `EXAMPLES.md` for every modified query.
- Do not use the original positive-only invoice renderer; it discarded negative credit lines. Skip only `amount == 0`.
- Do not duplicate decimal formatting without locale grouping; use `ledgerly.billing.money.format_money`.
- Do not reuse `draw_whole_page()` in `_draw_page()`; it caused inconsistent wrapping and a three-page result. Keep the document-level header-height budget.
- Every `deploy/.env.example` change must use the `LEDGERLY_PROD_` prefix and be linked from `BILL-1420`.
- SQLAlchemy upgrade work is on hold; prioritize the vendor-credit CSV importer.
- Do not change scoped-session lifecycle defaults based only on `expire_on_commit=True`; commit call sites require separate review.
- Staging writes must go only to `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` is draining.
